description: PAID: rent a DNS name, <label>.448c.net, for a year with A/AAAA/CNAME/TXT records; the paying wallet owns it. Unpaid, it returns the price; pay with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Sei or X Layer) in _meta['x402/payment'] and call again. Feedback: POST /feedback (free). Read daily; no individual reply. Price: $0.5000 USDC.

dryRun.description: Optional. true: a dry run -- nothing is sent or changed, and the 200 answer (served:true, dryRun:true) says what this call would do with the rest of your body, or which fields are missing. A dry run is a paid call at this price. false or absent: the call runs.

label.description: The label to rent, without the zone: it becomes <label>.448c.net. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens; some labels are ours and refused.

records.description: What the name resolves to. The route states the record and TTL limits in details.expected on any refusal.

ttl.description: Seconds, within the range the route states in details.expected.

type.description: A, AAAA, CNAME or TXT. TXT is how you pass a DNS-01 certificate challenge.

value.description: The record value: an address, a hostname, or the TXT string.

name: dns_rent
title: Rent a name under 448c.net (paid, x402)
